A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as the '''leader''' of a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Unidentified Czerka strike team|strike team]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the strike team apprehended former Czerka employee [[Kamus Orden]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], inside a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[SIS safehouse|safehouse]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Before they could [[Death/Legends|kill]] Orden, who had been working with SIS operative [[Fauler]], a Republic-allied individual arrived at the safehouse. In the ensuing skirmish the entire strike team, including the leader, was killed.

==Personality and traits==
The strike team leader had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a brown mustache.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
The team leader wore the [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] worn by most [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] employees during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which was green with yellow stripes. He also wore a belt, and two [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] hung at his thighs. A piece of technology covered his right eye.<ref name="TOR" />
